# Renewal negotiation: Varrow Racing

Date: 2026-09-10
Author: Tomas Ferreira

Attendees: Varrow legal counsel, Varrow head of data, Tomas Ferreira.

- Renewal terms agreed commercially; their legal team is reviewing the data-rights clause.
- They want service to continue without interruption after 30 September while legal review completes.

Actions: Tomas to confirm interim arrangement internally.
